summary: Hain Celestial filed an 8-K disclosing a September 12, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement to sell its International business (Ella's Kitchen, Joya, Natumi, Hartley's, Cully & Sully, Yorkshire Provender, New Covent Garden) to AURELIUS-affiliated purchasers for a gross price of EUR 233.0 million plus an approximately EUR 5.5 million locked-box ticker, roughly EUR 238.5 million or $323.2 million. Net cash proceeds are expected at EUR 225.1-228.8 million ($305-310 million), applied to reduce indebtedness. Closing requires UK, Austrian, Irish, German and Belgian regulatory clearances plus a credit-agreement maturity extension amendment by October 12, 2026. Watch regulatory timing and lender-consent risk.
